text: When they're standing right in front of you, kings are a kind of speech impediment.
author: Terry Pratchett
visual_brief: A precise engineering cross-section of a heavy, monolithic check valve assembly, showing an oversized weighted piston seated immovably across a conduit. Small dashed flow arrows approach along the intake pipe but terminate abruptly against the solid plug, accompanied by delicate technical callouts and dimensional witness lines.
alt: Engineering cross-section of a massive weighted valve blocking a flow conduit
